about.title: About Oro Nacional
about.subtitle: Jalisco tradition and elegance since 1990
about.ourStoryText: Oro Nacional was born in 1990 in the heart of Guadalajara, Jalisco, with the vision of creating fine jewelry that combines Jalisco's artisan tradition with contemporary designs. For over three decades, we have worked with passion and dedication to offer unique pieces that celebrate life's most important moments.
about.ourStoryParagraph1: Oro Nacional was born in 1990 in the heart of Guadalajara, Jalisco, with the vision of creating fine jewelry that reflects the cultural and artisan wealth of our region.
about.ourStoryParagraph2: What began as a small family workshop has become a jewelry store recognized for its commitment to exceptional quality and unique designs that combine tradition and modernity.
about.ourStoryParagraph3: Each piece we create tells a story, carries decades of artisan experience and the pride of being 100% Mexican. Our commitment is to offer jewelry that not only adorns, but becomes family treasures passed down from generation to generation.
about.teamDescription: Meet the artisans behind each unique piece. Passion, dedication and decades of experience in every creation.
about.jeweler1Specialty: Specialist in engagement and wedding rings
about.jeweler1Description: With over three decades perfecting his art, Master Roberto leads our team with incomparable passion and dedication.
about.jeweler2Description: Elena fuses Jalisco tradition with modern trends, creating unique pieces that tell stories.
about.jeweler3Specialty: Setting of precious stones and diamonds
about.jeweler3Description: Carlos's precision in stone setting is legendary, ensuring the security and beauty of each gem.
about.teamClosing: Our master jewelers have dedicated their lives to perfecting the art of jewelry. Each piece that leaves our workshop carries the invisible signature of years of experience, knowledge passed down from generation to generation, and a deep love for the craft.
about.processDescription: Each jewel goes through a meticulous artisan process that guarantees exceptional quality and unique designs.
about.step1Description: Each piece begins with a detailed sketch. Our designers work with you to capture your vision and create a unique design that reflects your story.
about.step2Description: We carefully choose certified 10k gold and the highest quality precious stones. We only work with reliable and ethical suppliers.
about.step3Description: Our master jewelers bring the design to life using traditional techniques refined over decades. Every detail is worked by hand with millimeter precision.
about.step4Description: Stones are set with specialized techniques that guarantee security and beauty. The final finish includes high-gloss polishing and rhodium plating when necessary.
about.step5Description: Each piece goes through rigorous quality inspections. We verify weight, gold purity, setting security and finishing perfection before delivery.
about.quote: Artisan jewelry is not just about creating beautiful objects, it's about preserving a millennial tradition, honoring manual work and creating treasures that transcend time.
about.certificationsDescription: Your trust is our greatest treasure. We back each piece with certifications and warranties that ensure your investment.
about.cert1Description: Each piece includes a certificate that guarantees the purity of 10k gold and the authenticity of the precious stones.
about.cert2Description: We offer a warranty on manufacturing and finishes. Free repairs for manufacturing defects.
about.cert3Description: All our diamonds have international certification that validates their quality, cut and characteristics.
about.cert4Description: Cleaning, polishing and professional review at no cost throughout the life of your jewel.
about.cert5Description: We work exclusively with certified suppliers that guarantee ethical and sustainable practices in mining.
about.cert6Description: 30 days for exchanges or returns. Your satisfaction is our number one priority.
about.excellence1Description: Spectrometry analysis to verify the exact purity of gold in each piece we manufacture.
about.excellence2Description: We record the origin of all our materials and the manufacturing process of each jewel.
about.excellence3Description: All our shipments are fully insured against loss, theft or damage during transport.
about.excellence4Description: We offer professional valuation service for insurance purposes at no additional cost.
about.certificationsQuestion: Have questions about our warranties or certifications?
about.contactUsText: and we'll be happy to assist you.
about.workshopImageAlt: Oro Nacional artisan jewelry workshop in Guadalajara
about.ourMissionText: To create the highest quality gold jewelry that captures the essence of special moments, keeping Jalisco's artisan tradition alive and offering exceptional service to each customer.
about.authenticGoldDesc: We work exclusively with certified 10k gold. Each piece includes an authenticity certificate.
about.artisanTraditionDesc: Our master jewelers have decades of experience in traditional Jalisco techniques.
about.customDesignDesc: We create unique pieces designed exclusively for you and your special moments.
about.lifetimeWarrantyDesc: All our pieces come with a warranty on manufacturing and authenticity.
about.ourWorkshopText: In our Guadalajara workshop, each piece is created with dedication and care. We use traditional techniques combined with modern technology to ensure the highest quality in every jewel.

contact.faq1Q: Can I schedule an appointment to see the jewelry in person?
contact.faq1A: Of course! We recommend scheduling an appointment to provide you with personalized attention. Call us or send us an email to coordinate your visit.
contact.faq2A: Yes, we specialize in custom designs. Our master jewelers will work with you to create the unique piece you imagine. The process takes 2-4 weeks depending on complexity.
contact.faq3A: Yes, we ship throughout Mexico with secure and trackable shipping. Shipping is free on purchases over $5,000 MXN. All our shipments are insured.
contact.faq4Q: How long does it take to respond to my messages?
contact.faq4A: We respond to all messages within 24 hours on business days. By phone, response time is generally immediate during our business hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions about our products, shipping and more.
faq.notFoundDesc: Our team is ready to help you. Contact us by phone or email and we'll respond shortly.

karat.q: What karat gold do you work with?
karat.a: We primarily work with 10k, 14k, and 18k gold. 10k gold is more durable and affordable, ideal for daily wear. 14k offers an excellent balance between durability and purity. 18k has higher pure gold content and a more intense color, perfect for special pieces.

solid.q: Are all your pieces solid gold?
solid.a: Yes, all our pieces are solid gold, never gold-filled, plated, or vermeil. Each piece is marked with its corresponding karat and comes with an authenticity certificate.

customize.q: Can I customize a piece of jewelry?
customize.a: Absolutely! We offer personalized engraving services and also completely custom designs. Our master jewelers can create the piece of your dreams. Schedule an appointment to discuss your project.

stones.a: Yes, we work exclusively with natural stones and authentic diamonds. Each piece with diamonds larger than 0.30ct includes a gemological certificate from an independent laboratory (GIA, IGI, or equivalent).

resize.a: Yes, we perform ring resizing. The first resize within 30 days of purchase is free. Subsequent resizes cost from $300 MXN depending on the piece.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept all credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express). We also offer interest-free installments on purchases over $3,000 MXN with participating cards.

installments.q: Can I pay in interest-free installments?
installments.a: Yes, we offer 3, 6, 9, and 12-month interest-free plans on purchases over $3,000 MXN with participating Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards. Available options are shown at checkout.

secure.q: Is it safe to shop online?
secure.a: Absolutely. All transactions are protected with 256-bit SSL encryption. We do not store card information. We process payments through certified and secure platforms.

layaway.q: Can I put a piece on layaway?
layaway.a: Yes, we offer a layaway system. With a 30% down payment, you can reserve your piece for up to 60 days. The remaining balance can be paid in bi-weekly or monthly installments. Contact us by phone or visit us in store.

invoice.a: Yes, we issue electronic invoices (CFDI) for all purchases. Just provide your tax information at the time of purchase or request it within 5 days by sending your information via email.

cost.a: No, all our shipments within Mexico are completely FREE, with no minimum purchase. We also offer express shipping (1-2 days) for an additional $200 MXN for urgent deliveries.

time.q: How long does it take for my order to arrive?
time.a: Free standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Guadalajara and metropolitan area: 2-3 days. Neighboring states: 3-4 days. Rest of the country: 4-5 days. Express shipping arrives in 1-2 business days.

tracking.a: Yes, once your order is shipped, you will receive an email with your tracking number (guide) so you can follow your package in real time to your door.

insured.a: Yes, all our shipments are fully insured against loss, theft, or damage during transport. In the unlikely event of an incident, we will replace your jewelry at no additional cost to you.

pickup.q: Can I pick up in store?
pickup.a: Yes, we offer the option to pick up at our store in Guadalajara at no cost. Select this option when completing your purchase and we will notify you when your order is ready (usually the same day or the next).

return.q: Can I return a piece of jewelry?
return.a: Yes, we accept returns within 30 days of purchase if the jewelry has not been used, modified, or engraved. It must be in its original packaging with all tags. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.

exchange.q: Can I exchange my jewelry for another piece?
exchange.a: Yes, we accept exchanges for another piece of equal or greater value within 30 days. If the new piece has a lower value, we issue a credit note valid for 6 months. Exchanges are unlimited during this period.

size.q: What if the size doesn't fit?
size.a: The first size adjustment is free if requested within 30 days of purchase. You can bring the ring to our store or send it securely. The adjustment takes 5-7 business days.

engraved.a: Personalized pieces with engraving are considered special orders and CANNOT be returned, they can only be exchanged for manufacturing defects. Please verify the spelling before confirming the engraving.

location.q: Where is your physical store located?
location.a: Our store is located in Guadalajara, Jalisco. You can visit us Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Find our exact address and map in the Contact section.

experience.q: Do you have experience in jewelry?
experience.a: Oro Nacional is a family jewelry business with over 25 years of experience. Our master jewelers have international certifications and master both traditional and modern fine jewelry techniques.

manufacturer.q: Are you manufacturers or just sellers?
manufacturer.a: We are manufacturers. We design and manufacture our own pieces in our workshop in Guadalajara. This allows us to offer competitive prices, exceptional quality, and complete personalization.

buyGold.a: Yes, we buy gold of any karat (10k, 14k, 18k, 24k) in any condition. We appraise it on the spot according to the international gold price. We also accept used gold as partial payment for a new piece.

contact.a: You can contact us by phone, email, or visit us in store. Find all our contact information in the Contact section. We respond to messages Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 8 PM.
